text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament approved a government bill that will establish a voter registration system which will be updated every year to ensure that all Mozambicans aged 18 and over are on the electoral register.
- Mozambique's government estimates that about 400,000 people are seriously affected by floods in the centre of the country. An appeal for emergency aid will be launched on Monday.
